purpose: Deterministic raster backstop for repository-owned SVG render fixtures

renderer.name: Chromium headless shell via Playwright Java
renderer.geometryAuthority: Chromium SVG DOM geometry, computed styles and transparent pixel masks

rasterEnvironment.viewport: intrinsic SVG CSS-pixel dimensions rounded up with 32 transparent CSS pixels on every side and visible root overflow; audit documents additionally add a 64 user-unit safety border on every side
rasterEnvironment.lifecycle: one non-persistent browser, context, and page per BrowserSvg; close() disposes all three
rasterEnvironment.network: offline context, blocked service workers, and catch-all route abort with no external URLs in admitted SVG
rasterEnvironment.telemetry: background networking, component updates, domain reliability, sync, crash reporting, translation, media routing, optimization hints, extensions, and default apps disabled

provenance.verification: The repository font and licence bytes match the named Fedora package files.

font.loading: The existing repository font is embedded as a data @font-face; document.fonts.load is forced before document.fonts.ready and document.fonts.check are awaited.
font.unsupportedGlyphPolicy: Runs containing glyphs absent from the pinned font are advisory font_missing and are not used for blocking geometry or contrast checks.

calibration.purpose: Environment probe gating raster-golden regeneration. Regeneration is refused unless this environment reproduces the baseline pixels below, judged by the same comparator the goldens use.
calibration.rationale: Complements the pinned CI container digest with a direct rasterizer-fidelity check. Chromium is Playwright-downloaded at the pinned version and the font is embedded as a data URI; the unchanged calibration gates baseline regeneration in every environment.
calibration.inputOwnership: Static repository-owned SVG, deliberately not produced by the render engine: a rendered fixture would move with the renderer and stop probing the environment alone.

comparator.thresholdRule: Differences of 8 or less in every RGBA channel are ignored; any channel difference above 8 changes the pixel.

generation.ownership: The PNG baselines are generated documents produced solely from repository-owned fixtures and renderer code using the test-profile Chromium headless shell and the bundled licensed font.
generation.pinnedEnvironment: The listed Playwright and Chromium versions, DPR, viewport rule and font digest.
generation.regenerationGate: Refused unless this environment reproduces the calibration baseline under the comparator below. Measures rasterizer fidelity directly rather than inferring it from the environment identity, so any environment that agrees with the committed pixels may mint baselines and one that does not may not, wherever it runs.
